purpose: Teach: いち早く/連ね/硬直/専任/クーポン/仕上がっ/大々的/各位

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文、いち早く、提出する習慣、つけろ、評価、変わってくるからな、本当に、若いうちに、覚えておけ、絶対。
lines.en: Ren — get into the habit of submitting papers early. It'll change how people evaluate you. You've got to learn this while you're young. Absolutely.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Leans forward slightly on the key clause. Warm underneath the firmness — not lecturing, investing. Lands hard on 「絶対」 with conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会発表者、名を、連ねる中で、僕も、頑張りたいと思っております、先生方、お力添え、ありがたいです、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I want to do my best among the conference presenters whose names are already listed. I'm truly grateful for the guidance from everyone here.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Slightly quickened pace, almost eager. Formal register held steady but with real warmth underneath. Soft landing on the gratitude at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究、硬直した、姿勢では、進歩、ないぞ、柔軟に、考えろ、若手の、強み、活かせ、絶対に、頑張れ、本当に、頼むぞ。
lines.en: Research stalls when your thinking gets rigid. You have to stay flexible. That's your strength as a young researcher — use it. I'm telling you, push yourself. Really.
lines.style: Firm pedagogical tone, but not harsh. Rhythm speeds slightly when moving into the directive. Lands weight on 「絶対に」. The final 「本当に」 carries worry beneath the authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室、専任の補佐、二名、雇っております、本当に、助かっております、効率化、進んでおります、最近。
lines.en: Yes. We've actually hired two dedicated assistants in the lab, which has helped tremendously. We're seeing real efficiency gains lately.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact report with quiet pride. Steady pace, professional register. A hint of relief in mentioning the practical solution. Slight uplift on 「進んでおります」.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学会のクーポン、参加費の割引、君も、活用しろ、研究費、効率的に、使うこと、覚えておけ、本当に、賢くな。
lines.en: The conference offers a registration discount coupon — you should use it too. Learn to use your research funds efficiently. Be smart about it.
lines.style: Practical, almost conversational after the formality. Brisk tempo. Light tap of pragmatism on each directive. Not unkind — mentoring through specifics rather than abstraction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文、ようやく、仕上がってまいりました、先生、本当に、お時間、いただきまして、ありがとうございました、感謝です。
lines.en: Yes. My paper is finally coming together. Professor, I'm truly grateful for the time you've given me. Thank you so much.
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. Slightly slower pace here — he's being careful with the formality because it matters. Warm register, respectful distance. Trailing quiet on the final thanks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学会で、大々的に、発表する機会、若いうちに、掴め、絶対に、君の財産になるからな、勇気を、持って、いけ、本当に、絶対だ。
lines.en: Grab the chance to present at the conference while you're young. This will become one of your greatest assets. Go in with courage. You have to. Really.
lines.style: Urgent but not frantic. Heat building beneath the steady surface. Lands hard on both instances of 「絶対」. The final 「本当に、絶対だ」 carries genuine belief — he's pushing because he sees potential.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩各位、ご指導、本当に、ありがとうございました、これからも、よろしく、お願いいたします、頑張ります、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Thank you all so much for your guidance and mentorship. I look forward to working with you going forward. I'll do my best. Really.
lines.style: Formal closing gratitude, but with genuine warmth breaking through. Slight bow in the voice — respectful but not distant. Steadies on the final commitment. Quiet sincerity at the end.
